brief:
Yair Smotrich told his allies in Israel's governing coalition that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could be ousted tomorrow, Ma'an reported. The far-right finance minister posed the question to coalition partners: what are they waiting for? His comments signal potential fractures within the coalition that has governed Israel since late 2022.

Smotrich's remarks come amid recurring tensions between coalition members over policy direction and resource allocation. The stability of Netanyahu's government has faced repeated challenges from its right-wing partners, though no immediate collapse appears imminent.

title: Smotrich pushes coalition partners to topple Netanyahu immediately
